name: campaign-brief-global
description: Use when a specific campaign needs a brief the whole team can execute from — context, objective, audience, core message, creative direction, channels, deliverables, week-by-week timeline, approval gates, and risks. Trigger on 'campaign brief', 'creative brief', 'launch brief', 'brief the team on this campaign', 'we are running a promo next month', 'what is the plan for this campaign'. Also use when the user describes a promotion out loud and asks for something the team can actually run. Not for — the whole period plan, see `marketing-plan-global`; the list of design files needed, see `campaign-asset-list-global`; assigning work to one person, see `team-brief-global`; a new product launch sequence, see `go-to-market-global`.
